title: Validate a TIP Editor SDK access token
content_data:
Use this endpoint to verify whether a TikTok Instant Page (TIP) Editor SDK access token has expired. Once you confirm a token has expired, you can renew the token using [/oauth2/access_token/tip_sdk/renew/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826847199234). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/oauth2/access_token/tip_sdk/validate/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | tip_sdk_access_token {Required} | string | A TIP Editor SDK access token.

If you want to create a new TIP Editor SDK access token, use [/oauth2/access_token/tip_sdk/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826755283969).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/oauth2/access_token/tip_sdk/validate/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "tip_sdk_access_token": "{{tip_sdk_access_token}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|is_valid| boolean |Whether the access token is valid.

Supported values: `true`, `false`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "is_valid": true } } (/code) ```
